_comment: Measurable targets per vibe, used by palette_report.py. Starting points set 10 Oct 2026 from the Go Mints page Harsh called dull; calibrate with every page Harsh judges (record the verdict and the metrics in references/calibration-log.md). Ranges are inclusive [min, max]; null = no limit.

metrics.white_share: share of the page that is near-white (lightness > 0.92, saturation < 0.10)
metrics.vivid_share: share that is vivid colour (saturation > 0.45 and 0.25 < lightness < 0.85)
metrics.colourfulness: Hasler-Susstrunk colourfulness: <15 not, 15-33 slightly, 33-45 moderately, 45-59 averagely, 59-82 quite, >82 highly colourful
metrics.chroma_saturation: mean saturation of the non-neutral pixels
metrics.hue_families: number of 30-degree hue families holding at least 4% of the non-neutral pixels
metrics.warm_share: share of non-neutral pixels with warm hues (reds, oranges, yellows: 0-60 and 330-360 degrees)

electric.for: energy, caffeine, sports nutrition, pre-workout, gaming, adventure

fresh.for: everyday supplements, clinical skincare, oral care, home care, hygiene

calm.for: sleep, stress, mental wellness, baby care, intimate care

premium.for: premium beauty, fragrance, jewellery, luxury gifting
